title: Ecological Garden
description: This mod allows players to manually build diverse environments and raise nearly 30 kinds of animals to obtain various products. It features rich ecosystems and complete food chains.
body:
Want to build your own exclusive natural kingdom in the blocky world?

This mod adds nearly 30 kinds of small animals. This is no ordinary breeding farm, but a complete ecosystem waiting for you to manage with care. Team cooperation, environment construction and genetic breeding — every step holds the secret to becoming an ecology tycoon!

Break away from monotonous traditional breeding. Every creature here has its unique living preferences. Grassland animals require plenty of grass blocks and tall grass. Desert dwellers rely on sandstone and cacti for shade. Forest creatures need logs and leaves for shelter. You can also create bamboo forests, flower fields, snowfields and more biomes by yourself. Plan your ecological zones reasonably and lay out proper environmental blocks to raise the ecological index above 60, which unlocks the full breeding rate of all animals. Witness them thrive and multiply in cozy habitats and gain a strong sense of achievement.

Enjoy a complete and relaxing gameplay journey from wilderness exploration to ecosystem construction. Press V to open the ecology guide and confirm ideal habitats. Catch lovely creatures with creature cages, or carry them home by holding Shift and right-clicking. Grow exclusive food for herbivores, build prey farms for carnivores, and place automatic feeders and water sources to keep all animals well-fed and hydrated. When animals show the production status, right-click with empty hands to collect precious products, sell them at trading posts for gold coins, and move steadily towards becoming a millionaire!

Rich in-depth gameplay satisfies your desire for exploration! The built-in realistic genetic system allows you to breed superior pets. Five genes including speed, weight and hunger resistance are inherited in accordance with Mendelian inheritance laws. Use gene analyzers and breeding guides to select high-quality parents precisely. You may even trigger gene mutations in harsh environments and breed one-of-a-kind exclusive creatures. Automatic collectors free your hands, pet hospitals extend your companions’ lifespan, and surveillance cameras let you teleport and monitor your ecological zones anytime. A full set of functional tools helps you build a fully automated ecological empire.

Happiness is better when shared! Start your team journey with 1200 starting gold coins. Build ecological zones together with friends with shared funds and clear division of labor. Some focus on environment construction, some devote themselves to genetic research, and others take charge of commodity trading. Write your unique ecological legend in the block world. There are also hidden cross-biome food chains to discover. You can either build efficient single-species farms or establish diverse nature reserves — the choice is all yours!

Build ecological barriers with blocks and guard lovely creatures with care. Ecological Garden lets you grow from an ecology beginner to a wealthy tycoon in Minecraft. Join now, give every little animal a warm home, and turn your ecological garden into the most stunning scenery across the blocky world!

在方块世界里打造专属自然王国？

本模组添加近30种小动物，这里不是简单的养殖农场，而是需要你用心经营的完整生态系统，团队协作、环境搭建、基因育种，每一步都藏着成为“生态大亨”的秘诀！

告别传统养殖的单调，这里的每只小动物都有“专属挑剔”：草原的小动物需要足量草方块与高草，沙漠的小可爱依赖砂岩与仙人掌遮阳，森林的毛茸茸则离不开原木与树叶的庇护，还有竹林，花海，雪原等环境，等你来亲手构建。你需要亲手规划区块的生态版图，用精准的环境方块铺设栖息地，让生态指标拉满到60以上，才能解锁小动物100%的繁殖率，看着它们在舒适家园里繁衍生息，让你有别样的成就感！

从野外探险到生态构建，玩法链完整又治愈：按V键调出生态图鉴锁定目标栖息地，用生物笼捕获心仪萌宠，或是悄悄Shift右键把它们扛在肩上带回家；为素食动物种满专属口粮，给肉食动物搭建猎物养殖场，再放上自动喂食器与水源，确保每只小动物都衣食无忧。当动物显示“已生产”提示，空手右键就能收获珍贵产物，送到贸易站秒变金币，朝着千万富翁的目标稳步迈进！

深度玩法更让探索欲拉满！自带真实遗传学的基因系统藏着培育“超级萌宠”的密码——速度、重量、耐饿性等5种基因，遵循孟德尔遗传定律代代相传，搭配基因分析仪与育种顾问，精准筛选优质亲本，说不定还能在恶劣环境中触发基因突变，培育出独一无二的专属品种。自动收集器解放你的双手，动物医院延长萌宠陪伴时间，监控摄像头让你随时可传送到生态区，随时查看生态区动态，全套工具助你打造自动化生态帝国。

独乐乐不如众乐乐！1200初始金币开启团队征程，和小伙伴共建生态区，金币共享、分工协作：有人专注环境搭建，有人负责基因研究，有人专攻产物贸易，在方块世界里书写属于你们的生态传奇。更有隐藏跨环境食物链等你挖掘，是打造单一物种的高效养殖场，还是构建包罗万象的自然保护区，全由你决定！

用方块搭建生态屏障，用爱心守护萌宠成长，《生态花园》模组带你在我的世界里，体验从生态萌新到千万富翁的蜕变。现在就加入，让每一只小动物都有温暖的家，让你的生态花园成为方块世界最靓丽的风景线！
